//go:build integration

package postgres_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Root-only ordinary owner lifecycle fixture. It does not write final path
// state directly; the existing Student pause API validates and commits it.
func TestT204PauseLowOwnerFixture(t *testing.T) {
	file := os.Getenv("T204_PAUSE_OWNER_EVENT_FILE")
	if file == "" {
		t.Skip("root-only ordinary owner pause fixture not requested")
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(os.Getenv("STUDENT_T20_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58999 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t20_student_integration_proof" || cfg.ConnConfig.User != "postgres" || cfg.ConnConfig.TLSConfig != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact isolated owner database required")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(file)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var event domain.EventEnvelope
	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &event) != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: owner envelope malformed")
	}
	var data domain.PlanningStateChangedData
	if json.Unmarshal(event.Data, &data) != nil || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(event.StudentID) || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(data.LearningPathID) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact owner identity required")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	repo := &postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	before, err := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, event.StudentID, data.LearningPathID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	current, err := repo.GetLearningContext(ctx, event.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err = repo.PauseLearningPath(ctx, event.StudentID, data.LearningPathID, current.Version, time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	after, err := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, event.StudentID, data.LearningPathID)
	if err != nil || after.Status != domain.LearningPathStatusPaused || after.Version != before.Version {
		t.Fatalf("ordinary owner pause state=%s revision=%d err=%v", after.Status, after.Version, err)
	}
	contextAfter, contextErr := repo.GetLearningContext(ctx, event.StudentID)
	if contextErr != nil || contextAfter.Version != current.Version+1 {
		t.Fatal("ordinary pause did not advance journey version exactly once")
	}
	t.Log("actual existing Student pause owner API keeps path revision and advances journey version; queued objective fact remains a fact, latest coherent snapshot sees PAUSED path; no final state SQL")
}
